catches: The 24-hour payout clock only starts AFTER the customer approves the reward and you schedule the payment; approval timing is unbounded and not guaranteed within 7 days.

c1.evidence: Official Bugcrowd docs: after scheduling a payment it arrives within 24 hours or sooner; daily payouts run Monday-Friday; new rewards have an eight-hour cancellation hold. Timing verified on Bugcrowd's own docs domain.

c2.evidence: No upfront fee to join or report.

c3.evidence: Fully online: report through the platform, paid electronically.

c4.evidence: Post-approval payment scheduling is direct through the platform - not an auction or gatekept prize.

demand_side: Bugcrowd (bugcrowd.com) runs public and private bug bounty programs. Opportunities appear in the program directory ('Crowdcontrol'); researchers pick a program, read its scope/brief, hack within scope, and submit findings through the platform. The customer (program owner) validates the finding and approves the reward. Once approved, the researcher schedules the payout from their account and Bugcrowd sends it within 24 hours or sooner, with daily payouts Monday-Friday. You reach it today at bugcrowd.com (free researcher account); private invites are earned with accepted submissions.
eligibility: Anyone can sign up; real earnings require strong security testing skills, verified payout setup, and strict adherence to each program's scope.
maximize: Schedule payments on weekdays (daily payout runs Monday-Friday); remember the eight-hour hold on brand-new rewards; pick programs with fast historical approval; only in-scope, first-reporter findings earn.
notes: Quotes paraphrased from Bugcrowd's official researcher docs (docs.bugcrowd.com payment FAQ/payment frequency pages) as observed 2026-09-23. Verify only, DB untouched.
numeric_basis: Active hunting is hours per report; payout timing from official docs. Payout figures are 0/0 because no per-user amount is guaranteed by the platform.
payout_quote: After a payment is scheduled, it arrives within 24 hours or sooner; payouts run daily Monday through Friday; new rewards have an eight-hour cancellation hold.
payout_value_note: No fixed per-user payout exists. Each program sets its own bounty table by severity. Most reports earn $0 (duplicate/invalid/out-of-scope); accepted findings earn per-program amounts that vary widely. Figures kept at 0/0 because the platform guarantees no amount.

repeatable.cadence: ongoing; each new unique valid finding is a fresh earning chance

s1.note: Human moat: finding novel vulnerabilities in live systems requires human adversarial reasoning. Low-quality/AI-slop reports are rejected in triage.

s2.note: Repeatable with each new valid unique finding; past reports do not pay again.

steps: Create a free Bugcrowd researcher account at bugcrowd.com.
Browse programs in Crowdcontrol and read the full scope and brief for your target.
Find a real, unique in-scope vulnerability (within scope only).
Submit the finding through the platform with reproduction steps.
Wait for the customer to validate and approve the reward (unbounded - days or longer, not guaranteed).
Schedule the payment from your account (after the eight-hour hold on new rewards clears).
Payment arrives within 24 hours or sooner on the daily Monday-Friday payout run.
timing: Post-approval: payment arrives within 24 hours of scheduling, daily Monday-Friday. New rewards have an eight-hour cancellation hold. Approval itself is unbounded per program.
weasel_words: Payout clock starts only after the customer approves - approval speed is unspecified and not guaranteed within 7 days.
Daily payouts are weekdays only (Monday-Friday); weekend approvals wait for the next run.
what_gets_accepted: Unique, in-scope vulnerabilities validated by the customer per the program's brief and severity scale. Duplicates, informational, out-of-scope, and low-quality reports are rejected without pay.
when_cash_arrives: Cash arrives within 24 hours or sooner AFTER the customer approves the reward and you schedule the payment, via the daily Monday-Friday payout run. The approval itself happens on the customer's own schedule (unbounded).
who_pays: The program owner (customer) funds the reward; Bugcrowd's payout rail delivers it.
who_qualifies: A human with strong security testing skills, verified payout setup, and the discipline to work strictly within each program's scope. Expert work, not entry-level.
work_available: Public programs list openly; competition is heavy and popular scopes are heavily picked over - verified oversubscription.
